law.citation: Abai, Zhetisu and Ulytau Regions were formed on 8 June 2022 from East Kazakhstan, Almaty and Karaganda Regions. Shymkent became a city of republican significance in June 2018, outside the region then renamed Turkistan. ISO 3166-2:KZ lists all four.

units.citation: Wikidata, the item whose ISO 3166-2 code (P300) is this unit's: English label, item id and code. The GeoNames id is the unit's row in GeoNames admin1CodesASCII.txt.

membership.citation: Each member is assigned to the region its Wikidata item is located in (P131), read on 2026-11-26. A member without a Wikidata item is assigned to the region that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under.

units.name: Abai
units.note: Ayagozskiy (1108785459) and Semey (1108785641) have no Wikidata item and are assigned by GeoNames, with 80% and 64% of their places in Abai Region.

units.name: East Kazakhstan
units.note: The Tarbagatayskiy record (1108785469) predates the transfer of its Aksuat area to Abai Region: GeoNames files 44% of the populated places inside it under Abai Region.
